text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Wah... It really does smell like haskap 
berries!\nThank you for the wonderful 
birthday present!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what brand is that perfume? If we 
spread the word to everyone, maybe they'll 
get interested in Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... I'm sorry. That was custom-made 
for me at a shop I frequent, you see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
So there isn't really a distribution 
network or anything, but— don't worry, 
it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If I win races and make a name for myself, 
people will naturally take an interest, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Both to the fragrance you wear, and to 
your beloved homeland.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're right. As a tourism ambassador, 
I'll carve out a path with my own two 
hands!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I'm counting on you. I believe you have 
what it takes to see this through."
